body.link:
<script type="text/javascript">
            Sepoa.cache.text.load({
                url:CONTEXT_NAME+'/resource/plugin/sepoasoft/screenbuilder/langs/'+Sepoa.info.LANGUAGE+'.js',
                def:CONTEXT_NAME+'/resource/plugin/sepoasoft/screenbuilder/langs/KO.js'
            });
        	(function(){
        		var a = [];
        		var p = "<%= CommonUtil.getConfig("sepoa.module.priority","FRWK") %>".split(",");
        		for(var i in p){
        			a.push({text:p[i], value:p[i]})
        		}
        		window.formModuleOption = a;
        	})()
    	</script>
